candidate.source_summary: URL query parameter 'start_time' from qute://history/data endpoint, converted to float
candidate.sink_summary: SQL query in history.py:entries_between() using string formatting instead of parameter binding
candidate.guard_summary: Float conversion validates numeric format but does not prevent SQL injection; no parameter binding used
candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled timestamp parameter directly interpolated into SQL query string without parameter binding
candidate.context_summary: qute://history/data endpoint accepts start_time parameter, converts to float, passes to history_data() which calls entries_between() with string-formatted SQL
unresolved_facts: Whether SQL injection is exploitable given float conversion constraints
Impact scope limited to history database access

target_cwe.description: The product constructs a log message from external input, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements when the message is written to a log file.
remediation_steps: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization
Use whitelisting approach for acceptable inputs

stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: While primarily SQL injection, the pattern of unvalidated input flowing to downstream systems could also affect logging
